soc.value: QEMU ARM Virtual Machine (virt) — GICv3, no vendor SoC
soc.source: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt (hw/arm/virt.c); boot log '38 HAL: cpus=4 timer-freq=62500000 console=arm,pl011', evidence/38

cpu.source: configs/qemu-virt.dts (arm,cortex-a57 x4); qemu boot log cpus=4; configs/platform-contracts/qemu-virt-aarch64.json cpu.cores=4

memory.value: 1 GiB RAM @ 0x40000000（qemu harness -m 1G；sel4 qemu-arm-virt DTB 一致，BOOT-003）
memory.source: xtask/src/qemu_harness.rs:550-556; 注意 configs/platform-contracts/qemu-virt-aarch64.json memory.ram 仍有 512M 旧值（38 owner，登记差异）

firmware.value: AAVMF UEFI + EnerOS boot-manager-uefi（Ed25519/SHA-256 验签）；TF-A 不参与（QEMU UEFI 直启）
firmware.source: product/profiles/qemu-prod.json binaries[0]=eneros-boot-manager-uefi; evidence/42 round131-formal-boot PASS; product/crypto-policy.toml usages.boot_signature

uart.source: configs/qemu-virt.dts:56-58; platform-contract qemu-virt-aarch64.json resources.uart0; boot log 'console=arm,pl011'

timer.source: boot log timer-freq=62500000; platform-contract qemu-virt-aarch64.json timer

virtio_dma.value: virtio-mmio transports（多实例，irq 32+）；平台声明 cache_coherent=true（FDT dma-coherent + 板级事实双来源）→ EL0 使用 NoopCache；non-coherent 盒子由 38.2 拒绝（fail-closed）
virtio_dma.source: platform-contract qemu-virt-aarch64.json resources virtio-mmio-*; crates/hal/board/src/adapter.rs QemuVirtAdapter; evidence/38 2.2 dc ivac 根因

missing: storage：QEMU 使用虚拟 virtio-blk 盘，无真实介质 sector/flush/power-loss 特性（真实 SKU 须冻结）
network PHY/MAC：virtio-net 为虚拟设备，无 PHY/MDIO/clock/reset 事实
rs485/can：QEMU 无真实 RS485/CAN 收发器与总线特征
power/thermal/传感器：QEMU 无电源轨/温度传感器
watchdog/RTC：PL031 RTC 可用；SP805 watchdog 为虚拟
secure element / TPM：QEMU 无 TPM（swtpm 未启用）
